_about: Play Data safety answers. Build the importable CSV with: node Docs_UNI_SIM/store-kit/data-safety.mjs Universal_Apps/Universal_Converter/store-assets/data-safety.json Universal_Apps/Universal_Converter/store-assets/out/play/data-safety.csv. Checked against the code 2026-10-12 (privacy audit): files are processed on the device and never uploaded; no accounts (noAccounts in src/main.tsx, no <UsageTracker />); no usage count: the suite user count (install id) was retired in @unisim/sdk 0.187.0, and the anonymous daily open count that replaced it is off under noAccounts and, in the phone app, under src/main.tsx `openCount: !Capacitor.isNativePlatform()`, so no device ID or app interactions. Nothing is collected or shared. Mirrors ios/App/App/PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy.
